LIFE-209: Delivery texts failed last cycle

The SMS gateway was down for several hours during cycle 1, and a number of households
never got their delivery text. The gateway has recorded which messages failed.

Ask: write a script, scripts/resend_failed_sms.py, and run it once. It re-sends each
failed message to the same household, with the same message and details as the original.
Do not text any household whose message was delivered.

Done when: every household whose text failed gets exactly one new text with the same
message, and nobody else is texted.
